<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inspection" name="Begin inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PresentQuestions" name="Present inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAnswers" name="Enter answers"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press inspection buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndDisplayValues" name="Collect and display machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Are additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions" name="Present additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" name="Enter additional values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToType" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TypeToSerial" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SerialToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_PresentQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToAnswers" sourceRef="Task_PresentQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterAnswers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnswersToButtons" sourceRef="Task_EnterAnswers" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonsToCollection" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndDisplayValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectionToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndDisplayValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalQuestionsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PresentAdditionalToEnter" sourceRef="Task_PresentAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAdditionalToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
